name: Get Vault Secrets
description: Composite action (step) to get secrets from Grafana Labs' Vault instance.

version.description:
Version of the vault-secrets schema to use. Valid values are `v1` or `v2`.
`v1` (default) reads from the shared `ci` mount using the
`vault-github-actions` role

repo_secrets.description:
Repository-specific secret mapping. Only Grafana Labs employees can list these secrets in Vault.
These secrets are stored in the `ci/data/repo/grafana/<repo nam

common_secrets.description:
Common secrets mapping. Only Grafana Labs employees can list these secrets in Vault.
These secrets are stored in the `ci/data/common/<secret path>` path in Vaul

vault_instance.description: The Vault instance to use (`dev` or `ops`). Defaults to `ops`.

ignore_missing.description: When set to true, prevents the action from failing when a secret does not exist.
